name: ワークスペース情報・プラン・招待のアカウントメニュー
prompt:
Recreate only the supplied Slack workspace account menu as a faithful Japanese localization. The exact crop is 352x365 pixels (0.964:1). Preserve the compact near-square floating menu with its light warm-gray background, fine separators, rounded top corners, and full-width layout. Do not add Tools & settings or any menu rows after Preferences.

At the top, show the dark rounded-square Slack workspace icon with a white 「S」, then the workspace name 「SLMobbin」 in bold and the URL "slmobbin-workspace.slack.com" in smaller gray text.

Below a fine divider, show a small hourglass icon and bold offer heading 「Proプランの特典終了まであと1日」. Under it, use two compact lines: 「Slack Proが最初の3か月間50%オフ。」 and a blue link 「プラン詳細を見る」. Center a wide white outlined button beneath with a small rocket icon and the label 「プランをアップグレード」.

After another fine divider, show two full-width menu rows with left-aligned dark text: 「SLMobbinにメンバーを招待」 and 「環境設定」. Keep row heights, left padding, text size, separators, and bottom crop consistent with the source. Use compact readable system sans-serif typography and restrained Slack styling. Preserve the 352x365 proportions. No profile avatar, extra rows, chevrons, or added content. Use the crop as authority for structure and visible state.
reviewNotes: Localized the SLMobbin workspace offer/menu while preserving the S icon, workspace URL, one-day Pro offer, 50% first-three-months copy, blue plan-details link, rocket upgrade button, Invite people and Preferences rows. Candidate 1231x1277 matches the 352x365 crop ratio within 0.1%; side-by-side review confirms row and separator alignment.
